title: Mirza hurries to the maktab
intro: A poem about a boy who can hardly wait to go to the maktab for the first time.

learn.alt: A father in a prayer cap walking hand in hand with his little son

learn.html:
Early in the morning, before the dawn,
Mirza got up out of bed,
he washed himself and got dressed,
all dressed up as if for Eid.

He is excited, all a-tremble,
he doesn’t say a word, he’s quiet,
he keeps peeking out the window,
looking out, waiting for his father.

No wonder he is like this –
yesterday his father promised
to walk with him to the mosque,
to take Mirza to the maktab.

There he will learn about Islam,
about Allah and the Qur’an,
about Allah’s beloved one,
Muhammad, the Prophet.
(Rešad Kadić)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Going to the maktab is a joy – there we learn about Islam, about Allah, the Qur’an and the Prophet Muhammad (SAW).

practice.title: What did Mirza do?
practice.prompt: Tap Mirza’s morning in the right order.
items: He got dressed, as if for Eid
They walked to the mosque together

questions.q: Why did Mirza get up so early?
options: He was going to the maktab for the first time
He was going on a trip
He couldn’t sleep because of the noise

questions.q: What did his father promise him?
options: To take him to the mosque, to the maktab
To take him to the park

questions.q: How did Mirza feel while he waited?
He got dressed up as if for…
What will Mirza learn about in the mosque?
options: Islam, Allah, the Qur’an and the Prophet Muhammad (SAW)

practice.title: Homework and talking
prompts: 🎵 Learn the poem about Mirza by heart.
🕌 Remember the first time you went to the mosque: who did you go with, and when?
😊 How did you feel in the mosque? Talk about it with your mu‘allim and your parents.
